They have struggled so far and they will be looking to come up with something different, probably change their plans. As the game heads into the afternoon session, the onus is on England Women to pick up wickets and restrict Australia's lead. The visitors will need to find a way to dislodge Healy and Sutherland, who are growing in confidence with every passing over. Can England Women fight back, or will Australia Women continue to dictate terms? We shall find out soon. Do join us in a bit post the Tea Break...
